application_credentials.description: Create an app at [oauth.yandex.ru]({oauth_console_url}): platform «Web services», put the redirect URI shown below into the app, and grant the Yandex.Disk REST API scopes for read, write and info. Then paste the app's ClientID and secret here. Details in the [integration readme]({more_info_url}).
